A farm running 275 keys cannot self-supply these, since each counter-bonding peer must be independent on the lantern graph and each one exposes its own stake to the same slash. Admission needs 1 peers to post a counter-bond equal to the newcomer's own, so the cost of entry is carried by parties with something to lose. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
